item.title: Smith+Nephew signs distribution agreement with SI-BONE
item.description: Smith+Nephew today announced it has signed a distribution agreement with SI-BONE, focused on their innovative iFuse TORQ portfolio. The post Smith+Nephew signs distribution agreement with SI-BONE appeared first on Orthopedics This Week.

item.title: Smith+Nephew signs exclusive US distribution agreement with RMR Ortho for patented technology that provides a unique dynamic compression nitinol fixation option (A’TOMIC™) to our surgeons
item.description: Smith+Nephew today announces it has signed an exclusive US distribution agreement with RMR Ortho to add the A’TOMIC™ Nitinol Fixation System to its portfolio. The post Smith+Nephew signs exclusive US distribution agreement with RMR Ortho for patented technology that provides a unique dynamic compression nitinol fixation option (A’TOMIC™) to our surgeons appeared first on Orthopedics This Week.

item.title: VB Spine Makes Bold Move Into AR Navigation
item.description: VB Spine has announced that it intends to acquire the rights to market and support Augmedic’s xvision Spine System®. The post VB Spine Makes Bold Move Into AR Navigation appeared first on Orthopedics This Week.

item.title: Stryker launches Synchfix™ EVT, expanding options for flexible syndesmotic fixation
item.description: Stryker announced the launch of Synchfix™ EVT, its next-generation flexible syndesmotic fixation device designed to simplify surgical deployment while supporting ankle stabilization in patients with syndesmotic disruptions. The post Stryker launches Synchfix™ EVT, expanding options for flexible syndesmotic fixation appeared first on Orthopedics This Week.

item.title: Does Timing of Radiation and Surgery for Spinal Metastases Matter?
item.description: Radiotherapy before, after or not at all for spinal metastases? The post Does Timing of Radiation and Surgery for Spinal Metastases Matter? appeared first on Orthopedics This Week.
